summary: The note describes Panduga Chesko, a 2015 Telugu family comedy-drama film directed by Gopichand Malineni and produced by Paruchuri Kireeti on the United Movies banner. It names the lead actors Ram, Rakul Preet Singh and Sonal Chauhan, supporting actors Brahmanandam and Sai Kumar, and the film's writers and crew. The note's title spells it Pandaga Chesko, while its body spells it Panduga Chesko.
one_line: Panduga Chesko is a 2015 Telugu family comedy-drama film directed by Gopichand Malineni and starring Ram and Rakul Preet Singh.
key_facts: Panduga Chesko is a 2015 Telugu family comedy-drama film.
Panduga Chesko was directed by Gopichand Malineni.
Panduga Chesko was produced by Paruchuri Kireeti on the United Movies banner.
The film features Ram, Rakul Preet Singh and Sonal Chauhan in the lead roles.
Brahmanandam and Sai Kumar play other important roles in Panduga Chesko.
The story of Panduga Chesko was penned by Veligonda Srinivas.
The screenplay of Panduga Chesko was provided by Kona Venkat and Anil Ravipudi.
Kona Venkat wrote the dialogue for Panduga Chesko.
S. Thaman composed the music for Panduga Chesko.
Arthur A. Wilson handled the cinematography of Panduga Chesko.
Gautham Raju handled the editing of Panduga Chesko.
